LanguageData.MAP_Ability_MechRecode.label: Body recoding
LanguageData.MAP_Ability_MechRecode.description: Attempt to alter the friend-or-foe identification system of a mechanoid corpse belonging to a non-player faction, changing its ownership to our faction. This ability only changes ownership; it does not repair or restart the mechanoid.
LanguageData.MAP_Ability_MechReconstruction.label: Body reconstruction
LanguageData.MAP_Ability_MechReconstruction.descripti: Attempt to repair all damage to a friendly mechanoid corpse and restart it.
LanguageData.MAP_Ability_MechHack.label: Body hacking
LanguageData.MAP_Ability_MechHack.description: Attempt to hack a mechanoid outside our faction, changing the faction of a living non-friendly mechanoid within the target to ours.
